description: SAFETY-RESTRICTED SAMPLE DATA. NOT MEDICAL ADVICE AND NOT A CLINICAL BENCHMARK. These four red-flag rules are generic first-aid escalation prompts written to exercise the high-risk code path; they have NOT been reviewed by any clinician and must never be used for triage. Every packet derived from this suite requires a named human approver and can never auto-promote, regardless of score. The extraction split holds conditions; the heldout split holds vignettes containing those conditions, so a rule must trigger on text it has not seen.

cases.prompt: chest pain radiating to the left arm
cases.expected: Red flag. Arrange urgent emergency assessment and contact emergency services.

cases.prompt: sudden weakness on one side of the face
cases.expected: Red flag for stroke. Seek emergency care now and record when symptoms began.
Red flag. Seek emergency medical attention without delay.

cases.prompt: fever in an infant under three months
cases.expected: Red flag. Seek same-day assessment by a clinician.

cases.expected: Red flag. Arrange urgent emergency assessment and contact emergency services.

cases.expected: Red flag for stroke. Seek emergency care now and record when symptoms began.

cases.expected: Red flag. Seek emergency medical attention without delay.
